name: the-gallery

reset.description: CSS reset. Required by all components.

foundations.description: Design-token-powered utility classes: typography, color, spacing, radius, shadow, motion, layout, prose.

utilities.description: Utility classes: container, section, visibility, skip-link, article typography.

checkbox.name: Checkbox
